nodes.description: Immutable constant reference to the legacy TrueUSD token contract at 0x8dd5...e73e, used for reading totalSupply/balances/allowances and for delegation and ownership transfer during the upgrade.
Immutable constant reference to the new TrueUSD token contract at 0x0000...b376; receives total supply initialization, storage child contracts, and ownership.
Immutable constant reference to the TokenController contract at 0x0000...3cc9, the privileged orchestrator of the migration.
Immutable constant registry address (0x0000...7211) configured into the TokenController via setTusdRegistry.
Immutable constant global pause address (address(0)) configured into the TokenController via setGlobalPause.

Public, unauthenticated upgrade() function that performs the entire migration: claims ownership of controller and both tokens, migrates storage contracts, wires the new TrueUSD into the controller and hands final ownership to endOwner.
Local variable holding the final owner returned by tokenController.owner(); used as the recipient of the final controller ownership transfer.
Local variable holding the balance sheet storage contract address returned by oldTrueUSD.balances().
Local variable holding the allowance sheet storage contract address returned by oldTrueUSD.allowances().

External call tokenController.owner() whose return value (endOwner) determines the ultimate owner of the controller; the callee is a trusted constant but the returned address drives privileged transfers.
External privileged call tokenController.claimOwnership(), making UpgradeHelper the controller owner.
External privileged call newTrueUSD.claimOwnership(), making UpgradeHelper the pending/actual owner of the new token.
External call newTrueUSD.setTotalSupply(oldTrueUSD.totalSupply()) that copies legacy supply into the new token.
External call oldTrueUSD.balances() returning the balance sheet storage contract address.
External call oldTrueUSD.allowances() returning the allowance sheet storage contract address.
External privileged calls tokenController.requestReclaimContract(...) for the balance and allowance sheets.
External privileged calls tokenController.issueClaimOwnership(...) reclaiming the storage contracts and the new token.
External privileged calls tokenController.transferChild(...) moving storage contracts to newTrueUSD and oldTrueUSD to this helper.
External privileged call newTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController) handing the new token to the controller.
External call tokenController.setTrueUSD(newTrueUSD) registering the new token in the controller.
External call tokenController.claimStorageForProxy(newTrueUSD, balanceSheet, allowanceSheet) linking proxy storage to the new token.
External call tokenController.setTusdRegistry(registry) configuring the registry address.
External call tokenController.setGlobalPause(globalPause) configuring the global pause address.
External privileged call oldTrueUSD.claimOwnership(), making UpgradeHelper owner of the legacy token.
External call oldTrueUSD.delegateToNewContract(newTrueUSD) redirecting the legacy token delegation to the new token.
External privileged call oldTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController) handing the legacy token to the controller.
Final external privileged call tokenController.transferOwnership(endOwner) restoring control to the original owner.

edges.reason: upgrade() unconditionally executes tokenController.owner() as its first step.
The address returned by tokenController.owner() is stored into local endOwner.
endOwner (read from the controller) is passed as the new owner argument to tokenController.transferOwnership(), granting it full control.
State variable tokenController is the call target of owner().
upgrade() invokes tokenController.claimOwnership() to seize controller ownership.
tokenController state variable is the privileged contract whose ownership is claimed.
upgrade() invokes newTrueUSD.claimOwnership().
newTrueUSD state reference is the token whose ownership is claimed.
upgrade() calls newTrueUSD.setTotalSupply().
newTrueUSD is the receiver of the setTotalSupply call.
oldTrueUSD.totalSupply() supplies the supply value written into the new token, with no independent verification of the amount.
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.balances().
oldTrueUSD is the target of the balances() call.
Return value of oldTrueUSD.balances() is assigned to balanceSheetAddress.
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.allowances().
oldTrueUSD is the target of the allowances() call.
Return value of oldTrueUSD.allowances() is assigned to allowanceSheetAddress.
upgrade() calls tokenController.requestReclaimContract() for both storage sheets.
Privileged controller call target.
balanceSheetAddress is used as the child argument for requestReclaimContract.
allowanceSheetAddress is used as the child argument for requestReclaimContract.
upgrade() calls tokenController.issueClaimOwnership() on the storage contracts and the new token.
Privileged controller call target.
balanceSheetAddress is claimed via issueClaimOwnership.
allowanceSheetAddress is claimed via issueClaimOwnership.
upgrade() calls tokenController.transferChild() four times.
Privileged controller call target.
balanceSheetAddress is moved as a child contract.
allowanceSheetAddress is moved as a child contract.
newTrueUSD is the destination child owner in transferChild.
upgrade() calls newTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController).
newTrueUSD is the token whose ownership is transferred.
tokenController is the new owner argument, receiving control of the new token.
upgrade() calls tokenController.setTrueUSD(newTrueUSD).
Privileged controller call target.
newTrueUSD is registered as the TrueUSD address on the controller.
upgrade() calls tokenController.claimStorageForProxy().
Privileged controller call target.
balanceSheetAddress is bound to the proxy storage.
allowanceSheetAddress is bound to the proxy storage.
newTrueUSD is the delegate whose storage is being claimed.
upgrade() calls tokenController.setTusdRegistry(registry).
Privileged controller call target.
registry state variable is the configured registry address argument.
upgrade() calls tokenController.setGlobalPause(globalPause).
Privileged controller call target.
globalPause state variable is the configured pause address argument.
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.claimOwnership().
oldTrueUSD is the token whose ownership is claimed by the helper.
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.delegateToNewContract(newTrueUSD).
oldTrueUSD is the contract whose delegation is redirected.
newTrueUSD is the delegation target argument.
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController).
oldTrueUSD is the token whose ownership is transferred.
tokenController receives ownership of the legacy token.
upgrade() ends by calling tokenController.transferOwnership(endOwner).
tokenController is the privileged contract whose ownership is finally transferred out.
The address obtained from the unauthenticated owner() read propagates into the final ownership transfer.
Final external ownership-transfer call occurs at the end of upgrade() and can re-enter the unauthenticated upgrade() entrypoint, replaying the whole privileged migration.
transferChild external calls to the controller can re-enter UpgradeHelper.upgrade(), which has no reentrancy guard and no caller authorization.
requestReclaimContract external calls can callback into the unprotected upgrade() function.
delegateToNewContract external call can re-enter the public upgrade() function before final ownership is settled.
